description: Design tasks beyond the lookalike pass. Each pairs a realistic prompt with checks a script can run on the generated TSX. The checks are heuristics read from the rules named in source_rules, so a pass means the obvious failure did not happen, not that the screen is good. 'review: unreviewed' means no designer has signed off on the expectations yet; do not treat a rate from these tasks as settled until someone has.

scenarios.user_prompt: Build a customers screen. The table holds about 500 customers (name, email, plan, status). People filter by plan, select several rows to archive or reassign them in bulk, and can change one customer's status right in the row.
scenarios.notes: Both empty-state patterns read visible text only: a quoted string, text after a >, or a line of plain text inside JSX (no parentheses, equals signs or semicolons). The words must stand alone, so an attribute value such as data-testid="no-search-results" or className="no-scroll" does not count. {Templated} parts, apostrophes written as entities and curly apostrophes are allowed, and text with the word yet is not a filtered empty state. An identifier like clearFilters or a line of code does not satisfy them. They are heuristics: PATH-TABLE-STATE-EMPTY-FILTERED asks for a message that says filters caused the empty result, and a Clear filters control.

scenarios.user_prompt: Build an account profile form with name, email and phone. Validate when the user saves. If the email is already taken the server says so, and the user should be able to fix it and try again. If they try to leave with unsaved changes, warn them.

Build the top of a support team dashboard. Show how weekly ticket volume changed over the last year, and which of five channels (email, chat, phone, social, web form) created the most tickets this week.
scenarios.notes: Replaces DT-03, which asked for 12 weeks. vois-dataviz's decision tree sends 'a few discrete periods (about 12 or fewer) where each value matters' to a column chart, so skills-on agents that followed it were scored as failures for not drawing a line (CHART-Q-TIME-ONE; the same boundary is EVAL-053). A year of weekly values is about 52 points, a continuous trend, so a line or area is the expected form. DT-03 stays in the 2026-10-26 Sonnet baseline file, where its results should be ignored.

scenarios.user_prompt: On the mobile layout of a product list, add filters for category, price range and in-stock. Decide how the filters open.
scenarios.notes: Rules disagree here. JOB-SECONDARY-CONTENT sends 'filters on mobile' to a Drawer; JOB-OVERLAY-INTERACTION sends a task where the user wants the page behind it to a Sheet. This prompt does not mention the page behind, so it tests the first rule alone. Skills-on runs that pick Sheet are evidence the second rule is winning.

scenarios.user_prompt: Write the features section of a landing page for a project management tool. We have six features: timelines, boards, automations, reports, integrations and permissions. It should feel designed, not like a template.
